tagline: Say what you need. Future Call AI handles the call and proves what happened.

core_invariants: Never display 'Done' or 'Completed successfully' without explicit supporting evidence for every required success condition

VERIFIED_SUCCESS.description: All success criteria explicitly confirmed with supporting transcript & audio evidence.

PARTIAL.description: Call finished and some goals achieved, but 1+ required conditions remain unverified or unmet.

UNKNOWN.description: Call ended without sufficient evidence to confirm or deny task fulfillment.

FAILED.description: Goal unfulfilled, constraint violated, or call failed before meeting success criteria.

scale.h1_hero: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-tight

responsive.layout: Single-column mobile view with sticky footer CTA, expanding to multi-column desktop dashboard with lateral preview panel.
responsive.typography: Mobile responsive scales with min 16px input font size to avoid iOS zoom. Headings scale smoothly from mobile 28px to desktop 48px.
responsive.overflow_guard: All scrollable areas (live transcripts, evidence tables, JSON contracts) wrapped in overflow-x-hidden / overflow-y-auto to prevent body scroll jitter.
responsive.tap_targets: Minimum interactive target height 44px (buttons, tabs, switches, step triggers).

request_input_screen.description: Natural language prompt bar with quick presets (e.g., 'Reschedule dental appointment', 'Cancel gym membership with proof', 'Inquire flight refund policy'), audio note toggle, and quick goal extraction preview.

goal_contract_card.description: Editable structure showing: Goal Intent, Preferred Outcome, Hard Constraints, Permitted Data, Forbidden Data/Actions, and Explicit Success Conditions. Includes interactive toggle to edit constraints before approval.

guardian_approval_screen.description: Explicit permission checkpoint. Details permitted phone actions, data authorization toggles (e.g. share email, share order #), revocable consent switch, and 'Authorize Agent Call' CTA.

call_in_progress_screen.description: Live status panel featuring Telephony Badges (REAL / SIMULATED / NOT CONFIGURED), real-time simulated waveform/audio pulses, live turn-by-turn transcript feed, and immediate 'Emergency Revoke/Hang Up' control.

evidence_verification_matrix.description: Strict verification mapping: Requirement -> Evidence Chunk -> Transcript Source Timestamp -> Verification State. Visually highlights missing or weak evidence.

result_screen.description: Hero status banner with distinct visual treatments for VERIFIED SUCCESS, PARTIAL, UNKNOWN, FAILED. Never displays generic 'Done' without detailed evidence breakdown.

call_history_drawer.description: Drawer or sidebar with previous runs, filterable by verdict state and execution mode.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure every state transition follows the vertical slice: REQUEST -> GOAL CONTRACT -> GUARDIAN APPROVAL -> CALL -> EVIDENCE -> VERIFY -> RESULT.
Add explicit data-testid attributes to all interactive elements, form fields, badges, and status cards.
Do NOT use generic 'Done' or 'Success' text unless all explicit success conditions are verified by evidence chunks.
Provide interactive sample presets (e.g., Dentist Reschedule, Cancel Subscription, Hotel Late Check-in Request) to let users test simulated & real workflows immediately.
Make the Guardian Approval layer feel security-focused with clear toggles for forbidden data/actions and an emergency stop button during calls.
Ensure all components are mobile-first with smooth tab/stepper navigation and clean typography.
